# The road's end: a little depot shed with a red roof (generated by make_env.py), origin at its foot.
new
material new Planks --base-color 0.620 0.502 0.361 --no-slot
material new Roof --base-color 0.486 0.271 0.271 --no-slot
material new Door --base-color 0.404 0.322 0.224 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Shed --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 1.000
scale 3.0 2.4 2.0
apply --scale
material assign Planks
add mesh cube --name Door --size 1 --location -0.400 -1.220 0.800
scale 0.9 0.06 1.6
apply --scale
material assign Door
add mesh cone --name Roof --vertices 4 --radius1 2.4 --radius2 0.05 --depth 1.3 --location 0.000 0.000 2.650
set rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
scale 1.0 0.75 1
apply --scale
material assign Roof
select all
shade flat
export depot.glb
